title: 2025 SAF Mandate fifth provisional 2026 publication QA controls

sources.title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics 2025: Fifth provisional release

facts.source_fact: The fifth provisional 2025 SAF Mandate statistics release was published on 23 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach release date to all extracted statistics.

facts.source_fact: The release covers sustainable aviation fuel supply for January to December 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the 2025 obligation period with all rows.

facts.source_fact: The fifth provisional release is based on data available as of 8 July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Store the data-cutoff date separately from publication date.

facts.source_fact: This is the fifth provisional report for 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Mark all values as provisional unless the final release supersedes them.

facts.source_fact: The fifth provisional release contains an incomplete dataset for the year.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret absence or totals as final completeness.

facts.source_fact: The complete finalised 2025 dataset is scheduled for publication in November 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Keep final-publication status pending until it exists.

facts.source_fact: The tables include amounts of UK aviation fuel from low-carbon and fossil-fuel sources.
facts.expected_handling: Keep fuel-category labels with volume data.

facts.source_fact: The tables report Sustainable Aviation Fuel Certificates issued to fuel meeting sustainability requirements.
facts.expected_handling: Do not equate certificate count directly with physical fuel volume without the defined conversion.

facts.source_fact: The release includes certificate balances by obligation period.
facts.expected_handling: Attach obligation period to certificate balances.

facts.source_fact: The tables include trades of SAF certificates between suppliers and traders.
facts.expected_handling: Keep transfer/trade records distinct from certificate creation.

facts.source_fact: The release includes carbon characteristics of SAF receiving certificates.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve carbon-method provenance with reported characteristics.

facts.source_fact: The release includes sustainability characteristics of SAF receiving certificates.
facts.expected_handling: Keep sustainability attributes separate from carbon-intensity metrics.

facts.source_fact: The tables include voluntary-scheme data associated with SAF.
facts.expected_handling: Retain scheme identity with voluntary-scheme records.

facts.source_fact: The release is published as official statistics by the Department for Transport.
facts.expected_handling: Carry publisher and official-statistics status as provenance.

facts.source_fact: SAF Mandate provisional releases are updated and may be revised before the final annual report.
facts.expected_handling: Use release-vintage keys when comparing provisional values.

facts.source_fact: 2025 is the first obligation year of the UK SAF Mandate.
facts.expected_handling: Do not compare pre-mandate years as equivalent obligation periods without mapping.

facts.source_fact: The mandate trajectory starts at 2% in 2025 under the published framework.
facts.expected_handling: Store mandate percentage as policy context, not observed supply.

facts.source_fact: The published mandate trajectory rises to 10% in 2030.
facts.expected_handling: Mark future mandate levels as policy targets rather than current performance.

facts.source_fact: The published mandate trajectory rises to 22% in 2040.
facts.expected_handling: Mark future mandate levels as policy targets rather than current performance.

facts.source_fact: SAF certificates are designed around the mandate rules including greenhouse-gas-reduction performance.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the certificate methodology and do not infer unsupported CO2e values from counts alone.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve official-statistics wording and provisional status.
Attach obligation year, fuel category and certificate/reporting boundary.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing volumes, certificates and sustainability attributes.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach data cutoff, release date and provisional-release number.
Carry DfT source/table and certificate methodology provenance.
Do not convert national SAF mandate statistics into parcel-level measured emissions.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
